# proxmox_user_tfa (Resource)

Manages one second-factor entry of a Proxmox VE user through `/access/tfa/{userid}`. Only the non-interactive types are supported: `totp`, `recovery` and `yubico` (`webauthn`/`u2f` need a browser registration ceremony). Proxmox rejects API tokens on these endpoints, so the provider must authenticate with a ticket; a non-`root@pam` identity additionally needs `password`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

# Proxmox rejects API tokens on TFA endpoints, so the provider must use ticket
# authentication. A non-root@pam identity additionally needs `password`.
resource "proxmox_user_tfa" "root_totp" {
  user_id     = "root@pam"
  type        = "totp"
  totp        = "otpauth://totp/root%40pam?secret=BASE32SECRET&issuer=Proxmox"
  description = "Laptop authenticator"
}

# Generated recovery codes are only known right after creation and are stored
# in state (sensitive).
resource "proxmox_user_tfa" "root_recovery" {
  user_id = "root@pam"
  type    = "recovery"
}

output "recovery_codes" {
  value     = proxmox_user_tfa.root_recovery.recovery_codes
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `type` (String) Factor type: `totp`, `recovery`, or `yubico`. Changes require replacement.
- `user_id` (String) User the factor belongs to, in `name@realm` form. Changes require replacement.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description distinguishing multiple factors.
- `enable` (Boolean) Whether the factor is enabled for login. The Proxmox default is `true`.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password of the authenticating identity. Required when the provider does not authenticate as `root@pam`.
- `totp` (String, Sensitive) `otpauth://` provisioning URI. Required for `totp`; Proxmox stores the shared secret, so the URI is kept from state and never read back. Changes require replacement.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Current OTP value. Required for `yubico` (Proxmox only keeps its public key prefix) and optional for `totp` as a verification code. Changes require replacement.

### Read-Only

- `entry_id` (String) Server-assigned factor id.
- `id` (String) Identifier in `user_id/entry_id` form.
- `recovery_codes` (List of String, Sensitive) Generated recovery codes, only for `recovery` entries and only known right after creation.
